# services/api/alembic/versions/83be959c9e94_check_changes.py

**Purpose:** The bulk initial-schema migration, autogenerated after the users table existed.

**Key contents:** Creates `exchange_rates`, `categories`, `chat_conversations`, `chat_messages`, `groups`, `group_invitations`, `group_members`, `recurring_expenses`, `recurring_expense_splits`, `settlements`, `expenses`, `expense_splits`, `ai_expense_drafts`, with enums, indexes and constraints.

**Depends on / used by:** Revises `c680f10680d5`; followed by `342fca98de7d`. Matches the models under `app/models/`.

**Decisions & caveats:** The vague name "check_changes" is historical. `exchange_rates` is created but still unused (no rate source; see decisions.md on currency). Groups use soft delete via `deleted_at` (a naive DateTime, unlike the timezone-aware `created_at`).
